actions.name: Baton Pass
actions.description:
Effect: The user leaves Combat (as per @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.MXPyYtoPDsZ4ByPh]{Recall}) and designates a creature on their Team, who then enters Combat (as per @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.XJ6olVrexEHDTqTM]{Send Out}). The designated ally gains the user’s @Trait[stage-change] effects, @Trait[pseudo-affliction]s, and other beneficial effects.

Restriction: This Attack can only be used by a creature that is part of a Team.
